third_party_evaluations.summary: OSINT methodologies: collection, verification, OPSEC, reporting.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Collection, verification, operational security and reporting form an end-to-end intelligence workflow supporting the recorded professional hint; the two-year profile and lack of described practical assessment limit a higher inference.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded collection, verification, OPSEC and reporting coverage supports professional OSINT delivery despite the two-year profile. Accreditation and COOL recognition add confidence, but no practical investigation or written-report assessment is specified.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded collection, verification, OPSEC and reporting methods are useful OSINT practitioner knowledge. With a two-year profile and no documented practical collection report, I place it below the professional source hint.
